title: The Hybrid Truck War of 2027: Ford Is Winning, and GM Doesn't Have One
description:
The hybrid truck war of 2027, company by company: Ford's record F-150 and Maverick hybrids, Toyota's V8-free Tundra, Stellantis canceling plug-in hybrids and the electric Ram, GM with no hybrid truck yet, and whether a hybrid truck makes sense for you. Every number comes from a published source, listed below.

Get the 2027 Truck Buyer's Guide: [LINK HERE]

Chapters:
0:00 Intro
2:11 Why hybrids, why now
4:58 Ford: the hybrid leader
8:21 Toyota: no more V8
11:40 Ram and Stellantis: the U-turn
14:37 GM: no hybrid truck yet
17:06 Scout, Kia and Hyundai
17:55 Hybrid vs plug-in vs extended-range
19:52 Should you buy one?
21:06 The verdict

Sources:
- The Washington Post via The Philadelphia Inquirer, the stealth rise of hybrids (July 11, 2026): https://www.inquirer.com/cars/cars-electric-hybrid-trump-ev-tax-credit-sales-automakers-toyota-honda-ford-gm-stellantis-20260711.html
